label: batch-90
tail:
Batch 90 is authored: **14 items** across the A/B pages, with manifests, source evidence, dependency records, proof contracts, and Step-1 decisions completed. Nine items are marked `ready`; five are `escalated`.

The main escalation is a mathematical conflict in the plan/spec: its arbitrary-baseline \(L\) omits the old-policy residual. For arbitrary \(f\), the exact identity needs the difference between the new- and old-policy residuals. I used that corrected formula locally and escalated the identity, theorem, CPO algorithm, approximation remark, and exact-versus-sampled example for owner reconciliation. The [Achiam supplement](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/achiam17a/achiam17a-supp.pdf) supports the correction; the algorithm’s candidate-to-current KL direction also matches the [paper’s trust-region convention](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/achiam17a/achiam17a.pdf).

Scoped checks passed: strict contracts **14/14**, proof layout **25 steps with 0 defects**, precheck, rendercheck, content-policy, dependency, forward-reference, external-prerequisite, coverage, and final stamped source-fetch checks. The run-wide dependency-level check passed for **1,247 items across 202 pages**.

The overall run remains open: autopilot reports scaffold coverage at **89/101**, and run-wide contract coverage currently finds the unrelated missing item `ex-multilabel-false-negative-risk-control`. The policy-gradients prerequisite page is still draft, though its direct differentiable-policy item has a ready record.
